newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Hub natgas called lower ahead of Tues expiry.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Hub natgas called lower ahead of Tues expiry.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures were expected to open marginally lower Monday as forecasts called for cooler weather in the East and Midwest by Tuesday, industry sources said.
August, which expires Tuesday, traded at $2.12-2.135 in over-the-counter after settling to the downside Friday at $2.146 per million British thermal units.
In anticipation of cooler air, early Monday cash prices at Henry Hub were talked a few cents softer at $2.17-2.19.
Chart traders said August support was at $2.10 and then at $2.07 and $2.051. Resistance was seen at $2.15, $2.20-21 and the $2.29 and $2.36 prominent highs.

In Friday's cash, Gulf Coast prices slipped a couple of cents to the high-teens. Midcon pipes were down one to two cents to the low-to-mid teens. New York city gate gas was also slightly lower around $2.40.

Although well above-normal temperatures are now blanketing the East and Midwest, cooler air is expected to arrive Tuesday. Slightly below-normal temperatures are also forecast for Texas by Wednesday, according to Weather Services Corp.
